title: Align Pending diagnostics smoke wording
summary: Aligns the Pending Publish row-detail smoke with the current selected-row diagnostic-order and focused-view text.
reason: The Pending diagnostics guidance panel intentionally renders row-specific diagnostic order while bridge controls live separately; obsolete bridge wording caused both smoke scenarios to fail.
behavior_before: The Pending Publish row-detail smoke expected Diagnostics bridge text inside the guidance panel and omitted currently rendered failed/evidence-missing focused views, so both smoke scenarios failed despite intentional UI behavior.
behavior_after: The smoke asserts the renderer's selected-row diagnostic order for ready and unreadable-manifest rows and the full intentional focused-view set for the unreadable-manifest case.
manual_validation: RED: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_row_detail_smoke failed with two obsolete Diagnostics bridge guidance expectations.
rollback_plan: Revert the smoke expectations if the Pending diagnostics guidance contract intentionally changes; no product behavior was modified.
notes: The focused-view expectation was updated only after the first guidance correction exposed the renderer's stable, unmodified failed/evidence-missing tags. No WebView product source was changed.
